## Research Themes

<div class="section-intro">Four strands, each tied to a concrete local problem.</div>

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### Pattern Recognition and Vision
<p>From paper forms to satellite and microscope images.</p>
- Election forms: automatic tallying with feature matching and CNN (ICACSIS 2019)
- Remote sensing: which CNN and ViT backbones transfer best
- Malaria microscopy: YOLO and CNN for *Plasmodium* detection
- Land cover: Sentinel-2 classification for Jambi with Random Forest
- Fish counter: embedded vision on device
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Predictive Systems
<p>Forecasts only matter if they help plan.</p>
- Oil and gas export values with SARIMA and LSTM (SATESI, 2025)
- Stock prices with LSTM (Media JISI, 2025)
- Education trends 2021-2023 with KNN
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Clustering and Segmentation
<p>Finding structure where labels are scarce.</p>
- K-means for customer segmentation
- Hierarchical clustering of provinces by gas use (JEKIN, 2025)
- Agglomerative clustering of fire hotspots in Bangka Belitung
- Visual and temporal features behind Instagram engagement
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Intelligent Systems
<p>Small systems co-built with students and partners.</p>
- Plant monitoring with IoT for SMK smart farming
- Financial data tools for Pondok Pesantren Darul Arifin
- Computational system design for teaching labs
:::

:::
